system.description:
You launch a condensed beam of star chakra at a target in range. Make a ranged Ninjutsu attack dealing 3d10 Force damage and forcing the affected creature to make a Constitution saving throw, being Bruised on a failure.

Irradiated: The beam is so suffused with Star Chakra that on a failed save, the affected creature is overcome with 1 rank of Star Sickness until the end of your next turn.

At Higher Ranks:  For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 (or 2 star chakra), and increase the damage dealt by 1d10 and if Irradiated, the ranks of Star Sickness by +1. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the number of creature you can target with this jutsu by +1. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, increase the number of creature you can target with this jutsu by +1.
